ja: 店頭販売アイテム ＭＳ本体（別売り）に組み合わせて、ガンダムバルバトスの各形態を再現可能な拡張パーツセットが登場！
『機動戦士ガンダム 鉄血のオルフェンズ』より、”ガンダム・バルバトス”が装備した各武装形態を再現できる、
武装とオプションパーツを拡張セットとして商品化。
1/100スケールとして初となるモビルワーカーが新規付属！オルガ・イツカのフィギュア(立ち)と新規デカールも同梱！
※ 当商品にＭＳ本体は付属しません。
※各形態を再現するには、組み立て前の「ＭＧ 1/100 ガンダムバルバトス」（別売り　店頭販売アイテム）が必要です。
●　第１・２・３・５・５地上戦仕様・６形態を再現できる武装類とオプションパーツを新規造形で再現。
ＭＧならではの密度と情報量を収めたディテールとギミックを搭載。
第１形態
両肩の装甲が外された状態。左腕の装甲とシールドを新規造形で再現。
第２形態
両肩のアーマーを新規造形。青と白のカラーリングを成形色で再現。
第３形態
特徴的な左腕のワイヤークロ―は、展開ギミックを搭載。
付属のリード線により射出シーンの再現が可能。
第５形態
地球降下作戦用の各装備を新規造形で再現。
シュヴァルベ・グレイズのものを流用した腰部ブースターはスラスター部の展開が可能。
腕部迫撃砲は射撃時の可動ギミックを再現。
第５形態地上戦仕様
ＭＳ本体ほどの長さのレンチメイスを新規に再現。連動ギミックにより開閉が可能。
腕部機関砲と大型化された脚部を新規パーツで徹底再現。接地性を考慮したラバーシールが付属。
第６形態
第５形態をベースに上半身に施されたアーマーの形状、カラーリングを新規パーツで立体化。
第６形態用の腰部ブースターを忠実に再現。
●　モビルワーカーが付属！
1/100スケールのモビルワーカーを初立体化。2種類の武装を組み替え式で再現可能。
選択式で一般機、指揮官機を再現できるほか、コックピットの開閉ギミックを搭載。
●　新規造形のオルガ・イツカのフィギュア（立ち）が付属。
●　新規デザインの水転写式デカールが付属！
鉄華団のロゴに加え、ギャラルホルンやボードウィン家の紋章、ダメージ表現用デカールといったバラエティー豊かなマーキングを収録。
〈セット内容〉
第１～第２形態用左腕パーツ ／ 第２～第３形態用肩装甲 ／ 第３形態用ワイヤークロー ／ レンチメイス ／
胸部反応装甲 ／ 腕部迫撃砲 ／ 腰部アーム ／ 第５形態用腰部ブースター ／ 第６形態用装甲 ／ 腕部機関砲 ／
第６形態用腰部ブースター ／ モビルワーカー ／ オルガ・イツカのフィギュア（立ち） ／ 水転写式デカール
１／１００スケール組み立て式プラモデル
対象年齢：１５才以上
製品素材：ＰＳ・ＰＶＣ・ＴＰＥ
・組み立てに接着剤は使用しません。
当商品は、「ＭＧ 1/100 ガンダムバルバトス」（別売り　店頭販売アイテム）に拡張して、

en: In-store sales item Introducing an expansion parts set that can be combined with the MS body (sold separately) to reproduce various forms of Gundam Barbatos!
From "Mobile Suit Gundam Iron-Blooded Orphans", you can reproduce each armed form equipped by "Gundam Barbatos".
Weapons and optional parts are commercialized as an expansion set.
The first mobile worker for 1/100 Scale is newly included! Olga Itsuka figure (standing) and new decals are also included!
*The MS body is not included with this product.
*To reproduce each form, "MG 1/100 Gundam Barbatos" (separately sold over-the-counter item) is required before assembly.
● Weapons and optional parts that can reproduce the 1st, 2nd, 3rd, 5th, 5th ground battle specifications and 6 forms are reproduced with new modeling.
Equipped with details and gimmicks that contain the density and amount of information unique to MG.
First form
The armor on both shoulders has been removed. The left arm armor and seal are reproduced with new modeling.
Second form
Newly sculpted armor on both shoulders. The blue and white coloring is reproduced with molded colors.
Third form
The characteristic wire claw on the left arm is equipped with an unfolding gimmick.
The injection scene can be reproduced using the included lead wire.
Fifth form
Reproduce each equipment for the Earth descent operation with new modeling.
The lumbar booster, which was adapted from Schwalbe Glaze's, has a thruster section that can be deployed.
The arm mortar reproduces the movable gimmick when shooting.
Fifth form ground battle specification
A new reproduction of a wrench mace that is as long as the MS itself. Can be opened and closed by interlocking gimmick.
The arm cannon and enlarged legs are thoroughly reproduced with new parts. Comes with a rubber seal for better ground contact.
6th form
Based on the fifth form, the shape and coloring of the armor on the upper body have been made three-dimensional with new parts.
Faithfully reproduces the lumbar booster for the 6th form.
● Mobile worker included!
The first three-dimensional version of a 1/100 Scale mobile worker. Two types of weapons can be reproduced by rearranging them.
In addition to being able to reproduce general aircraft and commander aircraft with a selection formula, it is equipped with a gimmick that opens and closes the cockpit.
● A newly sculpted Olga Itsuka figure (standing) is included.
● Newly designed water transfer decal included!
In addition to the Tekkadan logo, it includes a variety of markings such as Gjallarhorn, the Baudouin family emblem, and decals to express damage.
<Set contents>
Left arm parts for 1st and 2nd forms / Shoulder armor for 2nd and 3rd forms / Wire claw for 3rd form / Wrench mace /
Chest reactive armor / arm mortar / lumbar arm / 5th form lumbar booster / 6th form armor / arm machine gun /
Waist booster for 6th form / Mobile worker / Olga Itsuka figure (standing) / Water transfer decal
1/100 Scale Assembly plastic model
Target age: 15 years old and above
Product material: PS/PVC/TPE
・No adhesive is used in the assembly.
This product has been expanded to "MG 1/100 Gundam Barbatos" (separately sold over-the-counter item).
A set of 'arms/parts' to reproduce each (1st, 2nd, 3rd, 5th, 5th ground battle specification, 6th) form.
*The MS body is not included with this product.
* To reproduce each form of Barbatos, this product and the pre-assembly "MG 1/100 Gundam Barbatos" (sold separately) are required.
*The finished product in the photo is a prototype that is still under development. It is also painted. There may be slight differences from the actual product.
*Product materials may change depending on the production period of the sold product. Thank you for your understanding.
